description: Implementation of QuicEndpoint class for QUIC protocol simulation, including connection setup, data transfer, and frame handling.

classes.name: QuicEndpoint
classes.description: A class representing a QUIC protocol endpoint for simulation, handling connection setup, data transfer, and frame processing.

classes.name: QuicEndpoint::DataProducer
classes.description: Nested class responsible for producing stream data and crypto data for the endpoint.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::bytes_received
methods.description: Returns total bytes received by the endpoint.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::bytes_to_transfer
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes left to transfer.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::bytes_transferred
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes already transferred.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::AddBytesToTransfer
methods.description: Adds specified bytes to the transfer queue.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming stream frames and verifies data integrity.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::OnCryptoFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming crypto frames (empty implementation).

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::OnCanWrite
methods.description: Handles writable events to send data.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::WillingAndAbleToWrite
methods.description: Indicates if the endpoint is willing and able to write data.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::ShouldKeepConnectionAlive
methods.description: Indicates whether to keep the connection alive.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::AllowSelfAddressChange
methods.description: Indicates if self address change is allowed.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::OnFrameAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of frames.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::OnFrameLost
methods.description: Handles lost frames.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::RetransmitFrames
methods.description: Retransmits specified frames.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::IsFrameOutstanding
methods.description: Checks if a frame is outstanding.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::HasUnackedCryptoData
methods.description: Checks for unacknowledged crypto data.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::HasUnackedStreamData
methods.description: Checks for unacknowledged stream data.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::GetHandshakeState
methods.description: Returns the handshake state, always complete in this implementation.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::DataProducer::WriteStreamData
methods.description: Produces stream data by writing repeated bytes.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::DataProducer::WriteCryptoData
methods.description: Unimplemented method for writing crypto data.

methods.name: QuicEndpoint::WriteStreamData
methods.description: Sends stream data in chunks until all data is sent.
